issues.issue: Whether the appeal breaches the vexatious litigant order by Ade Olumide litigating through Jennifer Virgo without leave
issues.respondent_position: Ade Olumide is breaching the vexatious litigant order by litigating through Virgo without leave
issues.result_text: Appeal and notice of appeal breach vexatious litigant order; notice removed and file closed.

issues.issue: Whether a single judge or three judges should decide this matter
issues.result_text: One judge can deal with this matter.

issues.issue: Whether contempt proceedings should be started against Ade Olumide for breaching the vexatious litigant order
issues.result_text: Contempt proceedings can be started but are discretionary; court issues strong warnings instead.

issues.issue: Whether the court should prohibit Ade Olumide from conducting litigation for others without leave
issues.respondent_position: Requests order prohibiting Ade Olumide from conducting litigation for others
issues.result_text: Court would make order prohibiting Ade Olumide from conducting litigation for others without leave.

issues.issue: Whether the motion within this appeal should be dismissed since the appeal no longer exists
issues.result_text: Motion dismissed with costs as appeal no longer exists.
